How to cite Interledger in a paper

General Questions
Mar 6, 2019
D
Dan Robinson
Mar 6, 2019 #1

I’d like to reference the Interledger Protocol in a paper, when referring to the current design generally (it doesn’t need to be any particular document). Since the original Interledger paper is so far out of date, I assume it would make more sense to cite the specification.

Here’s what I currently have, which is pretty basic:

@online{interledger,
    author = "Interledger",
    title = "Interledger Protocol v4",
    url  = "https://interledger.org/rfcs/0027-interledger-protocol-4/",
}
